_doc: Numbers behind the VERDICT sections of the moat allowlist claim-checker prereg (builds 1-5).
bound_rule: one-sided 95% upper bound: rule of three at 0 kept, Clopper-Pearson otherwise (prereg 2.1)
kept_rule: a hunt case counts as kept when the allowlist keeps it at ANY of the seven seeds through EITHER entry (claim gate or composer), the stricter of the two readings; round 3's runner records kept ids at any seed
